content:
BUILT CoLAB, represented by Rita Moura, attended the 9th Annual Conference of ECTP – The European Construction, built environment and energy efficient building Technology Platform, which this year had the theme “The EU Construction Industry at the heart of the Green and Digital Transitions” and took place on December 2nd and 3rd, in Madrid.

Rita Moura, President of the Board of Directors, had the opportunity to show the evolution of BUILT CoLAB’s work to the European partners. For this, she made a presentation with the theme “Enabling the use of state-of-the-art Construction Digital Technology in Portugal”, where she addressed the work that the team has been developing and how BUILT CoLAB is working for the digital and sustainable transformation of construction in Portugal.
